arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)

for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {sheet} ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ---")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=15))

import sys
import pandas as pd

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("SHEET:", name)
    print("SHAPE:", df.shape)
    print("COLUMNS:", list(df.columns))
    print("DTYPES:", {str(c): str(t) for c, t in df.dtypes.items()})
    print("PREVIEW:")
    print(df.head(6).to_string())
    num = df.select_dtypes(include="number")
    if num.shape[1] > 0:
        print("NUMERIC COLUMN SUMS:")
        print(num.sum(numeric_only=True).to_string())
    print("TEXT COLUMN SAMPLE VALUES:")
    for c in df.select_dtypes(exclude="number").columns:
        print(c, "->", list(df[c].astype(str).unique()[:12]))
